fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the policy based route.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: Fully-qualified URL of the network that this route applies to, for example: projects/my-project/global/networks/my-network.

fields.label: Next Hop Ilb IP
fields.help: The IP address of a global-access-enabled L4 ILB that is the next hop for matching packets.

fields.label: Next Hop Other Routes
fields.help: Other routes that will be referenced to determine the next hop of the packet.

fields.label: Priority
fields.help: The priority of this policy-based route.

fields.label: Filter
Dest Range
fields.help: The destination IP range of outgoing packets that this policy-based route applies to.

fields.label: IP Protocol
fields.help: The IP protocol that this policy-based route applies to.

fields.label: Protocol Version
fields.help: Internet protocol versions this policy-based route applies to.

fields.label: Src Range
fields.help: The source IP range of outgoing packets that this policy-based route applies to.
The filter to match L4 traffic.

fields.label: Interconnect Attachment
Region
fields.help: Cloud region to install this policy-based route on for Interconnect attachments.
The interconnect attachments that this policy-based route applies to.

fields.label: Virtual Machine
Tags
fields.help: A list of VM instance tags that this policy-based route applies to.
VM instances to which this policy-based route applies to.
